recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-22650 unless Patient Care later revises the broader AllergyIntolerance note/description guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-22650 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for AllergyIntolerance.reaction.description to replace a "Comment field" reference with "note field".
initial_application: The issue was applied by 4e932d7372594bb1ebb807b24f7b79799f213532, which changed the old AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet source from "comment field" to "note field". The spreadsheet source is no longer present, but the corrected wording is preserved in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. The related FHIR-22713 audit already on the combined branch records that reaction.description had been handled by GF#22650 while separately auditing the lastOccurrence note-reference correction. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml already says the related event information should be captured in the note field, and no current AllergyIntolerance source contains the old comment-field wording.

related_jiras.note: It corrected another AllergyIntolerance comment/note reference and its Jira comments explicitly state AllergyIntolerance.reaction.description had already been updated by GF#22650.
